name: Order of Leitbur
description: The enemies of the Ironclaw Orcs.

timeline.summary: Followers of Leitbur make it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Order of Leitbur (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of Leitbur fares worse against Orcish and Goblin raiders.
timeline.quote: the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with Orcish and Goblin raiders.

citation.text: Order of Leitbur (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Followers of Leitbur guard pillaged transcriptions of the Hymn.
timeline.quote: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

citation.text: Hymn to Tourach (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Ironclaw fight the Icatian Empire using goblin kamikazes and mutations, creating the orgg.
timeline.quote: often using goblins as kamikazes and genetic mutations to fight the Icatian Empire
